#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000000;
const string BAD = "VK";
const string STR = "VKA";

int prepare(const string& s) {
    string res;
    for (char c : s) {
        if (BAD.find(c) != string::npos) {
            res += c;
        } else {
            res += 'A';
        }
    }
    return res;
}

string swap_chars(const string& s, int i, int j) {
    if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
    string buf = s;
    std::swap(buf[i], buf[j]);
    return buf;
}

int slow(const string& s) {
    string s2 = prepare(s);
    std::unordered_map<std::string, int> map;
    std::queue<std::string> que;
    que.push(s2);
    map[s2] = 0;

    while (!que.empty()) {
        string s_curr = que.front();
        que.pop();
        int curD = map[s_curr];
        if (s_curr.find_first_of(BAD) == std::string::npos) {
            return curD;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s_curr.size() - 1; i++) {
            string nxt = swap_chars(s_curr, i, i + 1);
            if (!nxt.empty() && map.find(nxt) == map.end()) {
                map[nxt] = curD + 1;
                que.push(nxt);
            }
        }
    }
    return -1; // Should not reach here
}

int fast(const string& s) {
    string s2 = prepare(s);
    int n = (int)s2.size();

    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
    vector<int> sz(3, 0);

    vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3);
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
        cntHere[c] = vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3, 0));
    }

    vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        a[i] = (int)STR.find(s2[i]);
        int c = a[i];
        if (sz[c] >= (int)cntHere[c].size()) {
            cntHere[c].push_back(vector<int>(3, 0));
        }
        cntHere[c][sz[c]] = pref[i];
        pos[c].push_back(i);
        sz[c]++;
        for (int c2 = 0; c2 < 3; c2++) {
            pref[i + 1][c2] = pref[i][c2];
        }
        pref[i + 1][c]++;
    }

    int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];

    // Initialize 4D DP array
    std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(sz0 + 1,
            std::vector<std::vector<int>>(sz1 + 1,
                std::vector<int>(sz2 + 1, INF))));

    int ans = INF;
    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; j0++) {
        for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; j1++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; j2++) {
                for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                    int idx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                    int curVal = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                    if (curVal == INF) continue;
                    if (idx == n) {
                        ans = std::min(ans, curVal);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (j0 < sz0) {
                        int c = 0;
                        int cost = std::max(j1 - cntHere[c][j0][1], 0)
                                   + std::max(j2 - cntHere[c][j0][2], 0);
                        dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], curVal + cost);
                    }
                    if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                        int c = 1;
                        int cost = std::max(j0 - cntHere[c][j1][0], 0)
                                   + std::max(j2 - cntHere[c][j1][2], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], curVal + cost);
                    }
                    if (j2 < sz2) {
                        int c = 2;
                        int cost = std::max(j0 - cntHere[c][j2][0], 0)
                                   + std::max(j1 - cntHere[c][j2][1], 0);
                        dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], curVal + cost);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int dummy;
    cin >> dummy; // read and ignore first integer
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    cout << fast(s) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
